summary: The door-opening sequence has a few real problems: the first door's panel jumps, a pillar-like beige shape stays in front of the doors, and a door knob glitches. The dancer is only visible at the end, in a stiff and symmetric pose.

faults.what: The cream door jumps from filling the frame to a narrow sliver at the right edge with the knob visible. Between 55.39 and 55.46 it snaps open with no in-between motion, and the upper panel outline shifts and looks broken at 55.43.
faults.fix: Add in-between frames or ease the door swing so the first door does not teleport open.

faults.what: A large beige cylindrical pillar stays in the left foreground across 55.36-55.63. It blocks about a third of the frame and the door action, and it reads as a stray object rather than a door.
faults.fix: Move the camera or the pillar so the view through the doors is clear.

faults.what: A second small gold knob appears next to the main knob at 55.79-55.83. It looks like a duplicated or clipping knob, and the main knob then sits on the green bush at 55.89-55.96, so the door and bush appear to overlap.
faults.fix: Remove the duplicate knob and move the bush so it clears the door.

faults.what: The dancer is cropped at the right edge, and his arms hang in a stiff, symmetric pose with little line of action. His expression is blank.
faults.fix: Re-center him in frame and give him a stronger pose and a facial expression.
